name: chat.stopStream

channel.desc: An encoded ID that represents a channel, private group, or DM.

chunks.desc: Array of streaming chunks. Can include markdown text chunk objects, task update chunk objects, plan update chunks, or blocks chunks.

ts.desc: The timestamp of the streaming message.

markdown_text.desc: Accepts message text formatted in markdown. Limit this field to 12,000 characters.

blocks.desc: A list of blocks that will be rendered at the bottom of the finalized message.

metadata.desc: JSON object with event_type and event_payload fields, presented as a URL-encoded string. Metadata you post to Slack is accessible to any app or user who is a member of that workspace.

session_status.desc: The session status to set after stopping the stream.

safety_note_for_agents: This catalog documents Slack's UNDOCUMENTED/internal API surface for a specific workspace (Hack Club, Enterprise Grid). Calling an undocumented method with params_known=false means you would be guessing params against a real backend with unknown side effects -- do not do this against a real account/token without a human in the loop, and never call anything shaped like a write (*.delete, *.set, *.remove, *.create, *.update, and similar) without explicit human confirmation and a clear understanding of the blast radius, even when params_known=true.
